# Disposable e-mail domains: a hand-written floor, checked in with the code.
# One domain per line. Case-insensitive; a subdomain of a listed domain is
# also treated as disposable. Keep this list to providers that are
# unambiguously throwaway — false positives lock real people out, and the
# generic "temp mail" style domains are the safe ones. The maintained list
# (10k+ domains) is generated by tools/update_disposable_domains.py and is
# NOT committed (upstream licence is NOASSERTION).
